Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function log2() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultLog2  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).log2 (); // creates a UnaryLog2UGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultLog2  =  log2(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryLog2UGen
See also:
